description.value: Nan Adventure Tours is a 100% Indigenous-owned and operated boat-tour company based in Bella Coola, BC, running day trips into the Great Bear Rainforest with a Nuxalk captain. Tours include soaks at remote hot springs, wildlife viewing in fjords and inlets, and cultural interpretation at ancient village sites and totem poles. For a cyclist exploring the Central Coast, this offers a rare chance to experience the surrounding wilderness by water with local Indigenous knowledge.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and detailed, confirming Nan Adventure Tours is an active boat-tour business in Bella Coola, BC, offering hot springs, wildlife, cultural, and harbour tours led by an Indigenous guide. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, showers, or any cyclist-specific amenities appears anywhere on the site — the operation is water-based and departs from the Bella Coola wharf. Phone numbers on the website match the OSM record; no street address is provided in either source.
concerns: No street address available in OSM or on the website; tours depart from the Bella Coola wharf but no fixed civic address is listed.
OSM record has no osm_id or tags — this record appears to originate entirely from the manual additions list rather than a mapped OSM node.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly bookable tour business in Bella Coola — a notable attraction for touring cyclists passing through the area.
enrichment_extras.notes: The business operates from the Bella Coola wharf. Contact email nanadventuretours@gmail.com is listed on the website but not in the OSM record.
